name: How do expert witnesses strengthen a federal criminal defense?

mainEntity.name: How do expert witnesses strengthen a federal criminal defense?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expert witnesses, such as forensic accountants or digital analysts, clarify complex evidence, refute government claims, and help the jury or judge understand technical aspects key to the defense case.heathhydelawyer+1​
